unit: Geometry · Chapter XI. Areas and volumes

stages.headline: Volume tells how many unit cubes fit in a body; a cube with 1 cm edge has volume 1 cm³.
stages.headlineEnglish: Volume tells how many unit cubes fit in a body; a cube with 1 cm edge has volume 1 cm³.

stages.headline: Properties: equal bodies have equal volumes, and a body cut into parts has the sum of their volumes.
stages.headlineEnglish: Properties: equal bodies have equal volumes, and a body cut into parts has the sum of their volumes.

stages.headline: Units: 1 m³ = 1000 dm³, 1 dm³ = 1000 cm³, 1 l = 1 dm³.
